correctness.rationale: The fixed point of 0->01,1->21,2->0 has complete n-factor sets for n<=8 because independently regenerated prefixes attain rho(n)=2n+1, which is the published all-n factor-complexity theorem. Independent generation yielded rho 3,5,7,9,11,13,15,17 and reflection classes 3,3,6,7,10,12,15,17. Its full 17-element length-8 set contains no reverse pair; length 7 has only reversible 1012101, a palindrome. Any longer reverse pair would induce a reversed length-8 prefix/suffix pair, giving the all-n cutoff without extrapolation. Scope: only this morphic ternary word, not all low-complexity sequences.
